content: Inngest: steps are checkpointed, independently-retriable units of work; step.run memoizes results so a failed run doesn't restart from scratch; step.sleep suspends a workflow for seconds-to-months at zero cost with no polling/cron/idle workers; fan-out to multiple downstream workflows without partial-send risk on retry; runs on the user's own compute (serverless/container/server), no separate infra to operate; local dev mode (inngest dev) mirrors cloud behavior for testing before deploy.
